summary: Bug-fix verification: Settings -> Profile 'v.trim is not a function' crash (Brevo /v3/account returns address as OBJECT). VERIFIED FIXED. Frontend-only testing per request. (1) App boots cleanly to the Brevo login gate — no crash, no red screen, 0 page errors. (2) Deep-link to /settings/profile renders the Profile screen WITHOUT crashing: all 5 rows (First name, Last name, Email, Company, Address) render with '—' fallback for missing values; no '[object Object]' artifact; no error toast on open. (3) Back button (testID header-back-button) works — deep-linked case falls back to /login (router.canGoBack() false -> replace); in-session it would return to Settings. (4) Static verification of app/settings/profile.tsx: dash() is now type-safe (null/undefined->'—', string->trim||'—', number/bool->String, objects/arrays->'—'); formatAddress() joins street/zipCode/city/country filtering empties, '—' fallback; Address row correctly uses formatAddress not dash; all other dash() call sites (firstName/lastName/email/companyName) pass typed strings per Account type. (5) Runtime logic simulation in Node confirmed: formatAddress({street,city,zipCode,country}) -> '55 rue d'Amsterdam, 75008, Paris, France'; partial objects, empty strings, null all handled; dash(addressObject) -> '—' (old crash path now safe). (6) Metro bundler compiled cleanly (1391 modules), no compile/red-screen errors for profile.tsx. Cannot verify live session rendering of a real address object in web preview (OAuth deep-link round-trip impossible) — but the pure-function logic was executed with the exact real Brevo payload shape and passes.

action_items: Remove the temporary diagnostic console.log('[profile] account.address = ...') at /app/frontend/app/settings/profile.tsx:30 before release (E1 confirmed it was temporary).

Fix stale type: Account.address is declared 'address?: string' in /app/frontend/src/lib/brevo.ts:59 but Brevo /v3/account returns an object {street, city, zipCode, country} — update the type to the object shape (or unknown) to match reality and avoid future type confusion.
MINOR: formatAddress() returns '—' if address ever arrives as a plain string (legacy/API variance); consider `if (typeof a === 'string') return a.trim() || '—'` for extra robustness.
OPTIONAL: bump expo to ~54.0.37 and expo-constants to ~18.0.14 to clear Metro compatibility warnings.

On-device smoke test with a real Brevo session: confirm Address row shows the formatted one-line address and no toast on open/back (only acceptance criterion not verifiable in web preview — logic already proven via Node simulation).

formatAddress() filters empty/whitespace parts before joining — no leading/trailing separators; correct '—' fallback.

Type mismatch remains in src/lib/brevo.ts:59 (address?: string vs actual object) — runtime-safe due to cast in profile.tsx, but misleading; flagged in action_items.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: Brevo GET /v3/account returns 'address' as an OBJECT {street, city, zipCode, country}, but the old dash() helper assumed a string and called v.trim() -> TypeError 'v.trim is not a function' crashing the Profile render. Fix: dash() made type-safe (unknown input handling, objects -> '—') and new formatAddress() renders the address object as 'street, zipCode, city, country'. Verified: no reproduction of crash; object payload now renders readable one-liner (Node simulation); missing values render '—'; no '[object Object]'; no error toast; back navigation safe.
